verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote mark, headline, attribution and rating on one left edge (only the logo is slightly indented), but the headline is undersized for the tall canvas, the gaps between the headline and attribution and between the attribution and rating are too loose, and the attribution and rating text is tiny. B has the same small type, and its left edges are ragged: the quote mark sits at about x80, the headline at x56, the attribution at x43 and the logo at x55. It also leaves a large dead area below the logo, which makes the layout top-heavy and look arbitrary.
